rationale: Build on the current best tail-EMA script by extending EMA coverage from float-kept tensors plus projection weights to the full model during the quant-aware tail. The final metric is the exact int8 roundtrip score, so smoothing the large quantized matrices as well is a direct attempt to reduce late-training noise where quantization error matters most. I kept the faster 0.94 decay for float-kept/projection tensors that already helped in run 0017, and added a slower 0.972 decay for the remaining matrices so they smooth without freezing too aggressively inside the short 600s endgame.
title: Full-Model Tail EMA For Quant-Aware Endgame
